text.card: A red giant 3,172 parsecs away, 24 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.84 solar masses and 24.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,265 K at its surface.
